scenarios.title: migration: ORNA-UPGRADE-004

scenarios.title: migration: ORNA-UPGRADE-007
given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.
when: Exercise the rule, its rejected inputs and the relevant concurrency/recovery boundary.

scenarios.title: migration: ORNA-UPGRADE-008
given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.

scenarios.title: migration: ORNA-UPGRADE-009
given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.

when: Exercise the rule, its rejected inputs and the relevant concurrency/recovery boundary.

given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.

scenarios.title: index and checkout: ORNA-CHECKOUT-003

given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.

given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.
when: Exercise the rule, its rejected inputs and the relevant concurrency/recovery boundary.

given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.
when: Exercise the rule, its rejected inputs and the relevant concurrency/recovery boundary.

given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.

given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.

given: A disposable database using the final format and the actual production implementation.
